summary: Keller Group plc provides specialist geotechnical services in North America, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific. The company offers ground engineering solutions, including ground improvement services, grouting, deep foundations, earth retention, marine, and instrumentation and monitoring services, as well as post-tension systems and industrial services. It also provides bearing capacity/ settlement control, low carbon construction, containment, excavation support, stabilization, marine structures, seepage control, slope stabilization, and monitoring solutions. In addition, it provides environmental remediation and demolition. The company provides its services to the construction sector in commercial, industrial, infrastructure, institutional/public buildings, power, and residential markets. Keller Group plc was founded in 1860 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
